Class AutomaticRunLabels

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.listeners.internal.AutomaticRunLabels
public final class AutomaticRunLabels extends Object
Default Allure labels derived from the run configuration (#7053): target operating system (os), software-under-test type (sut) and execution location (location). Each value is added as a dedicated label and as a key:value tag so merged reports can filter and group runs. Labels a test already set by hand are kept and not duplicated. Disable with allure.automaticRunLabels=false.
